FirstRun.title: First run
FirstRun.body: This is the first screen when TILL has no workspace open. You choose one of three doors: create a fresh workspace, restore one from a backup file, or adopt a TILL book that already lives on this machine. To adopt, TILL restarts briefly and then opens that book; the file stays where it is. Nothing is created silently, since each door confirms before it writes, and until you pick one, no books exist yet. When an adopted book is not reachable, this screen says so and offers to try again, choose another book or forget it.

residency.lead: Your books are a single file on this device. Nothing is sent. Disk encryption is the operating system's job (FileVault).
